HexKagune 1.3.7 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 57, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- Eto's Mutated Arm: once she's serious, from range her right arm turns to flesh and shoots out at you, swinging after you with its weight; whatever its hand hits is caught, hurt and carried.
- Thrown, it drags what it caught back to her and flings it out to her side.
- Maniac, she mostly holds it out: it swells and reaches further, and at the full charge folds into a sphere round what it caught, crushes it three times, opens and draws back in. With nothing caught she lets it go.
- She keeps walking at you with it out (as a player does), and throws nothing else until it's back in her.
- Same rules, timings, animation and effects as the player's Mutated Arm, at her size. The arm drops what it holds if she dies; players who come into view see it already out.
